key.name: intelligent-hide-enabled
key.description: Automatically hide the top bar based on focused window and pointer position.

key.name: hide-when-maximized-only
key.summary: Hide only when focused window is maximized
key.description: If true, the top bar only hides when the focused window is maximized.

key.name: reveal-edge-threshold-px
key.description: When pointer Y is within this threshold from top edge, top bar is shown.

key.name: visible-opacity
key.description: Opacity used when top bar is visible.

key.name: hidden-opacity
key.description: Opacity used when top bar is hidden.

key.name: pointer-poll-interval-ms
key.description: How frequently the extension checks pointer position for reveal behavior.
